description: In Texas, opportunity abounds. For Houston native Violeta Nuñez, such an opportunity presented itself after leaving the U.S. Air Force — when she took a leap of faith and used the GI Bill to go to welding school.

title: From U.S. Air Force to Journeyman Pipefitter: How a Houston Native and Mother of Four Switched Careers to Help Build a Bigger, Brighter Texas - Greg Abbott
